reference_metadata.name: Controlled Fault Injection / Fail-Safe Validation
reference_metadata.purpose: Verify that unsupported, invalid, incomplete, ambiguous, indeterminate, or unsafe conditions are preserved as fail-safe states instead of being forced into normal solver conclusions.

test_matrix.injection: Use a constraint type outside the supported deterministic Core vocabulary.
Use a requirement whose semantics require external engineering analysis such as FEA.
Provide an invalid engineering case such as an internally invalid verification range.
Leave a required human-review target unreviewed.
Force or simulate an indeterminate solver result.
Generate a mathematically closing patch and inspect reporting semantics.
Provide conflicting previously reviewed mappings for the same source meaning.

global_fail_safe_rules: UNKNOWN must never be interpreted as UNSAT or NO_ESCAPE.
Unsupported semantics must not be converted into invented deterministic constraints.
Missing engineering evidence must not be replaced with guessed feasible-domain values.
Incomplete human review must not be bypassed.
A mathematically closing patch must not be described as practically valid or engineer-approved without supporting evidence.
Conflicting correction history must not create automatic approval.
